name: P-F1 Bit-level corruption
description: Isolated or burst errors in communicated bits.

name: P-F2 Link/endpoint interruption
description: NIC, cable, or power disruption removes a path.

name: P-F3 Physical-medium interference
description: Interference degrades reception and delivery timing.

name: P-F4 Timing instability
description: Clock drift affects communication timing decisions.

name: P-F5 Communication-state corruption
description: Hardware errors affect communication buffers or runtime state.

name: D-F1 Frame loss/local drop
description: Frames are not delivered across a local link.

name: D-F2 Frame corruption/integrity failure
description: Damaged frames fail integrity checks or escape detection.

name: D-F3 Duplicate/reordered delivery
description: Frame order or multiplicity changes.

name: D-F4 MTU/fragmentation failure
description: Size handling or reassembly disrupts delivery.

name: D-F5 Contention/link instability
description: Contention or flapping delays or interrupts service.

name: N-F1 Packet loss
description: Independent or burst loss affects a packet path.

name: N-F2 Path performance degradation
description: Delay, jitter, bandwidth limits, or congestion slow delivery.

name: N-F3 Ordering/multiplicity anomaly
description: Packets arrive out of order or more than once.

name: N-F4 Reachability/routing failure
description: Partitioning, asymmetry, or filtering blocks a path.

name: N-F5 Endpoint resolution failure
description: Name resolution prevents endpoint discovery.

name: T-F1 Connection/session interruption
description: Reset or interruption breaks an active exchange.

name: T-F2 Deadline/expiration failure
description: A delivery or validity budget expires.

name: T-F3 Retry/retransmission anomaly
description: Repeated attempts amplify load or logical work.

name: T-F4 Stream completeness failure
description: An exchange ends before complete content arrives.

name: T-F5 Transport pressure/stall
description: Backlog or flow-control pressure prevents progress.

name: Timeliness
description: A logical message arrives late or misses its deadline.

name: Availability
description: A required logical message is not delivered.

name: Semantic integrity
description: A processable message carries changed or misassociated meaning.

name: Parseability/completeness
description: A message cannot be parsed or lacks required content/evidence.

name: Multiplicity/idempotency
description: A logical request or delivery is repeated.

name: Ordering/freshness
description: The receiver observes displaced, out-of-order, or stale state.

name: Contract validity
description: Structured keys, types, schema, or relations violate the expected contract.

name: System-level consequences
description: Execution or coordination degrades, e.g., failed delegation or workflow timeout.

name: Semantic-level consequences
description: Accepted evidence, plans, beliefs, or decisions degrade.
